messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — p95 latency spike for model-serving-prod (svc=redwood-runtime). Current p95 620ms (>alert 500ms) across eu-west-1. Severity: P2. Paging primary: @Maya secondary: @Sam. Link: https://pager.redwood/incident/2275000000
Maya: on it — switching to primary, grabbing canary logs.
Sam: I'll take secondary and watch customer queues. what’s the observed customer impact?
Priya: seeing 500–800ms for a subset of generation requests hitting kvcache-miss. Affects ~3% of total requests, primarily long-sequence interactive sessions. no increase in 5xxs.
Maya: sounds like kv-cache warmup. mitigation idea: throttle batch size and scope a temporary alert threshold bump so we don’t wake the whole rotation for noise. propose: p95 alert 500ms -> 750ms for 30m in eu-west-1 only. thoughts?
Alec: +1 for scoped temporary bump. make sure it’s auditable and auto-reverts. also add a regression eval run after we stabilize.
Sam: 30m sounds ok. scoped to region is ideal. want to avoid muting unrelated signals.
Maya: updating alert to be region-scoped and timeboxed. running update command now: 
```bash
alerts-cli update --alert p95-latency-serving-prod --region eu-west-1 --threshold 750 --duration 30m --reason "kvcache warmup - oncall mitigation"
```
Maya: executed — alert updated. incident-bot should confirm.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook pointer: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/kvcache-warmup — recommended steps: 1) reduce batch_size for warm containers, 2) roll restart small pod subset, 3) monitor kv hit-rate and p95, 4) schedule postmortem if >5% error budget burn.
incident-bot: ALERT UPDATED by Maya — threshold set to 750ms for 30m scoped to eu-west-1. Pager suppressions for this signal are active in that region.
Priya: applying mitigation: decrementing default batch from 64 -> 32 on canary pool, will watch latency delta. starting a controlled restart of 5 pods.
Alec: rolling restart observed; no uptick in 5xxs so far. keep an eye on tracing for increased token time.
Maya: FYI I notified SRE lead (cc) to track burn rate. also logging this as a temporary SLO exception with note "kvcache warmup — oncall mitigation".
Sam: support notified in #support-escalations to prep customer comms if we see any continuity impact.
Maya: plan: 30m mitigation window, then auto-revert alert. if p95 remains high after mitigations, escalate to infra with capacity plan.
Priya: after first restart p95 dropped to 420ms on canary, global p95 trending downward.
Alec: good. re-run of the regression eval queued (tag: oncall-2275000000).
Maya: closing loop: will keep monitoring for next 20m; reopen if errors or 5xxs surface. add this to later postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
Sam: noted. thanks team.
Maya: marking as monitoring and handing primary to Sam in 15m for overlap.
Sam: acknowledged — taking primary at 2275000900.
